title: mentha longifolia var. polyadena
intro: Mentha longifolia var. polyadena, commonly known as Horse Mint, is a perennial herb native to the Mediterranean region. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, as well as its ability to soothe digestive issues and alleviate respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Horse Mint include its use as an antispasmodic, carminative, and expectorant, making it useful for treating conditions such as coughs, colds, and indigestion. Bioactive constituents of Horse Mint include essential oils like menthone, isomenthone, and limonene, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
